faqs.question: Can I use this hair serum for dandruff during the day?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can apply during the day. Make sure you apply it for at least 6 hours.

faqs.question: Will this dandruff serum make my hair dry?
faqs.answer: No, this effective formulation of tea tree oil, menthol in combination with zinc pyrithione & ICHTHYOL® PALE does not not dry your hair.

faqs.question: Will this scalp serum for dandruff give instant relief?
faqs.answer: Yes, it gives an instant and long lasting cooling effect to relieve you from itching and inflammation. You can notice reduction in dandruff from the first wash and significant results in 2-3 washes

faqs.question: Is Bodywise Anti Dandruff Serum safe to apply at night? Will the hair serum irritate my skin?
faqs.answer: This serum is completely safe to use and doesn't cause any side effects.

faqs.question: Does this dandruff serum come with an applicator?
faqs.answer: The bottle comes with an inbuilt applicator which makes it easy to use and apply.

faqs.question: Is this  dandruff hair serum applied on hair strands or just on the scalp?
faqs.answer: Since this is a treatment serum, it's recommended to part your hair and apply it directly on your scalp.
